title: No-Show Fee Carried by a Missed In-Person Appointments Visit
content:
The no-show fee a missed In-Person Appointments visit carries is the visit type's no-show fee when the visit's status is no-show, and nothing for a visit in any other status.

The figure is reckoned in one order: the visit type's no-show fee is raised first; sums added to or taken off the fee then apply to that figure; a reduction by a percentage is applied to the figure so reached; and the no-show fee the missed visit carries is rounded to the cent only at the end. The visit type's no-show fee is the figure in the fee schedule.

| Status on the appointment record | No-show fee the visit carries |
|---|---|
| No-show | The visit type's no-show fee, reckoned as above |
| Completed, cancelled, booked, confirmed or checked in | Nothing |

**Worked figures (hypothetical missed visits).**

- An Established Patient Office Visit closed as a no-show: the visit type's no-show fee is $50.00, and the fee the missed visit carries, rounded to the cent, is $50.00.
- An Advanced Imaging Appointment closed as a no-show: $150.00.
- An Advanced Imaging Appointment that was cancelled rather than missed: nothing.

The status read is the one on the appointment record of the visit itself.
